definitions.explanation: Describes a way of doing things that is methodical, unpretentious, and involves sustained effort rather than shortcuts or flashy methods.

examples.japanese: {地道|じみち}な⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{地道|じみち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: She has been continuing her research steadily.

examples.japanese: ⟦{派手|はで}→派手：03563_hade⟧な⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、{地道|じみち}な{積|つ}み{重|かさ}ね⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つながる。
examples.english: Rather than flashy methods, steady accumulation of effort leads to results.

notes:
USAGE:
{地道|じみち} is almost always used approvingly. It praises the kind of quiet, unglamorous work that produces reliable results over time.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地道|じみち}な⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧ (steady effort)
- {地道|じみち}な⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧ (painstaking work)
- {地道|じみち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (to keep at it steadily)
- {地道|じみち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ (to work honestly and steadily)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{地味|じみ}→地味：01573_jimi⟧ means "plain" or "understated" and focuses on appearance, while {地道|じみち} focuses on behavior and emphasizes diligent, methodical effort.
